text:
zoe: Quick layover life-saver thread  share one weird item that saved you during an overnight layover. :sleeping: :airplane:
marc: Earplugs + eye mask = magic. also a tiny travel towel folded into a pillow. :zzz:
priya: Snack swap idea  I carry instant miso packs + ask cafes for hot water. trade for granola bars at the gate? react with :hand:
devon: Brought a $12 power strip and charged 3 people. best $12 ever. :plug:
travel-bot: Reminder: If you buy food/items for teammates, submit under "team travel incidentals" with receipts within 7 days.
rachel: Mini first-aid kit saved me for blisters. tip: blister bandages fit inside headphone case.
marc: Also: ask the lounge/airport info about lost & found before tossing sealed water bottles. sometimes they have spares.
priya: Micro-poll: would you rather 1) snack-swap table 2) group bulk snack buy 3) solo survival pack? react 1/2/3
devon: 2 for me  less packaging and fewer decisions.
zoe: I'll add a "layover-share" section to the offsite logistics doc with a tiny kit checklist:```
- earplugs + eye mask
- instant hot beverage packs
- reusable cutlery
- small powerbank or power strip
- blister bandages
```
rachel: Meetup: gate 12 @ 10:30 for snack swap. Ill bring extra miso packs.
priya: Ill bring granola bars. See you there! :raised_hands:
